the development of a neuromorphic mid-air gesture recognition system.
the development of an event-based mid-air gesture recognition system that can encode event-based data and classify gestures at high temporal resolution.
the development of novel algorithms and hardware for the analysis of mid-air gesture events and the creation of a self-supervised, event-driven learning system.

the proposed model can be used to encode gesture data at high resolution and with high accuracy.
the Hybrid Guiding-VAE is a viable alternative to traditional deep neural network architectures for encoding and learning from event-based data.
